newsitem.title: INDIA: India eases forex long term forward cover rules.
newsitem.headline: India eases forex long term forward cover rules.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Saturday authorised dealers in foreign exchange could now provide long term cover without its prior approval.
Earlier, they were permiited to provide long term cover on an outright basis for longer periods subject to RBI approval.

"On a review of the matter, it has been decided that in cases where market quotes are not available, authorised dealers may quote forward rates using money market factors and/or extrapolation of on-going rates without the prior approval of the Control," The RBI said in a statement.
"The gaps that arise from covering such transactions should however be within the approved gap limits," it added.
